name: Jelana
overview: Fast, cached playback analytics inside Jellyfin.
description: Standalone Jellyfin analytics with its own playback collection and an hourly, atomically replaced snapshot. The UI never performs live analytics queries.

versions.changelog: Replace four overview tiles with two tabbed Server-wide cards and move Monthly trend alongside them. State Personal or Server-wide scope directly in every card title, add a Jellyfin home button, and introduce the new Jelana analytics logo.

Make every value in My Analytics follow the selected 30-day, one-year or all-time period, including viewing habits, longest session and movie/TV split. Add an explicit color legend and Personal or Server-wide scope badges to every dashboard card.
Use English throughout the entire UI, menu integration, cached labels and source documentation so Jelana can be used internationally. Preserve 24-hour time formatting.

Add cached personal viewing habits, longest session and movie/series split. Add Hot Right Now, unique viewer counts and a rolling monthly trend. Bundle an optional JS Injector menu integration for regular users.
Fix the personal statistics tabs so only the selected period is visible instead of rendering 30 days, one year and all time as three stacked rows.

Add a same-server user dashboard at /Jelana/User for non-admin Jellyfin users. Add private per-user cached viewing statistics for 30 days, one year and all time. Move activity to row two, place Media Profile and Playback last, and remove Recently Added from the analytics page.

Move the 30-day activity chart to its own full-width row and add a responsive Swedish date axis beneath the bars. Combine clients and playback methods in a tabbed Playback card. Make posters and titles in the most-played rankings open their Jellyfin detail pages. Exact graph values remain available on hover, keyboard focus and mobile tap.

Replace crowded library/media layout with separate Library and tabbed Media Profile panels. Add 7/30-day tabs for new items and mobile-first 44px touch targets, single-column cards, readable typography and tap-accessible chart details.

Add activity-chart hover values, tiny posters to movie and series rankings, consolidate detailed Playback Reporting methods into Direct play, Direct stream and Transcodes, and move video, resolution and audio profiles beside library information.
Load dashboard CSS from JavaScript into Jellyfin's main document because Jellyfin discards plugin-page head assets. Adds asset cache-busting and Swedish 24-hour update timestamps.

Embed the complete responsive dashboard styling directly in the Jellyfin plugin page so cards, grids, charts, rankings, and recent posters render correctly regardless of base URL or stylesheet routing.

Use Playback Reporting exactly as the standalone Jelana dashboard does. Adds hourly read-only analytics, the 30-minute session rule, 7/30-day rankings, library statistics, media profiles, activity, atomic snapshots, and no live queries from the UI.
Initial development release: standalone playback collection, hourly atomic cache, authenticated snapshot API, and integrated statistics page.
